mintAuthority.summary: AUDF uses a 2/5 Admin Safe that holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Avalanche; on Redbelly the Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE while MINT_ROLE is currently unassigned and can be granted through the Safe. The same Safe owns the shared ProxyAdmin path across the five issuer-native deployments. Polygon and Base additionally have a separate operational EOA MINT_ROLE holder. The Ethereum LayerZero OFT adapter is bridge machinery assessed only under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: AUDF Admin Safe (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINT_ROLE, multichain)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573497, Safe reads returned version 1.3.0, the listed five owners, threshold 2, and no enabled modules; prior reviewed Safe state records a zero guard. Confirmed DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE on Ethereum, Polygon, and Base via role logs; on Avalanche confirmed DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE via hasRole; on Redbelly the Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE while MINT_ROLE is currently unassigned. ProxyAdmin on Ethereum (0x2dcafce3b4fc7aba1b822637b12d6156fc85edd9) is owned by this Safe, and the shared implementation/proxy-admin pattern is re-confirmed on Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche at the current review blocks. The Ethereum OFT adapter is not part of this native control.

controls.label: AUDF Polygon/Base EOA MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: RoleGranted logs on Polygon and Base both show this EOA holding MINT_ROLE (role hash 0x22435ed...) alongside the Admin Safe. eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). This appears to be Forte's operational minting key.

review.evidence: The 2/5 Admin Safe remains the native DEFAULT_ADMIN and MINT_ROLE authority on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Avalanche, while Redbelly retains DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE with MINT_ROLE currently unassigned. The shared implementation 0xc9357d8fb84dd3041612dc5b2a2cd914d9405572 and ProxyAdmin path are re-confirmed on Ethereum block 25770091, Polygon block 92138647, and Avalanche block 92973884; Redbelly's reviewed block 3075429 shows the same implementation and ProxyAdmin with the Safe holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Operational EOA minter 0xfd5d8237da011a140949eb23517fbbb9edf142ce remains scoped to Polygon and Base. The Ethereum StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter and its Safe ownership are assessed only under Bridge Risk. Direct Safe/EOA mint paths and the Safe-controlled upgrade path have no independent quantitative cap, so the economic cap remains unbounded. Forte's monthly independent audit evidence supports periodic reconciliation; ASIC/AFSL conduct licensing is not a named prudential issuer supervisor, so supervision remains attestation-only.
